name: Operation Ouch! Clonewards
summary: Operation Ouch! Clonewards is a browser-based medical simulation game based on the hit CBBC series, Operation Ouch! Take on the Clonewards challenge with Dr Chris and Dr Xand. Keep your patients moving through the hospital to keep them happy. Remember - the more patients you treat, the more your hospital can grow! Pay attention to your patients, because if left untreated for too long, they will explode into a pile of snot!
